title: Which Song Do You Most Want Jay-Z to Perform at the 2027 Super Bowl Halftime Show? Vote!
summary: The star has a lot of hits -- and quite a few potential guest performers -- to choose from.
contentText:
Jay-Z is about to show the world what he’s got with his long-awaited Super Bowl Halftime Show debut, and Billboard wants to know which songs from his iconic three-decade discography you most want to see him perform.

Related

Jay-Z to Headline 2027 Super Bowl Halftime Show: ‘GOAT’s Out of the Bag’

Jay-Z’s Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show: Our Dream Setlist

NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell Says He Requested Jay-Z Take Super Bowl Stage ‘Whenever the Moment Felt Right’

The news arrived on Monday (Oct. 26) that, after seven years of curating Apple Music’s Super Bowl halftime lineup through his Roc Nation company, Jay would be taking the stage himself. “GOAT’s out of the bag,” read the caption of Apple’s announcement on Instagram, which featured a video of the 25-time Grammy winner sitting among a bevy of goats in stadium seats.

“From Reasonable Doubt to standing on the Super Bowl Halftime stage, this has been a journey,” Jay said in a statement. “Thirty years of music, work, and culture on the world’s biggest stage. This run continues to be a dream come true.”

There are few contemporary stars with as rich of a catalog as the New York native, and speculation over what he’ll play on Feb. 14, 2027, at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, Calif., has already begun. ( Billboard has already curated our dream setlist.) He’s topped the Billboard Hot 100 four times and has too many all-star collaborations to name, from his work with superstar wife Beyoncé to Alicia Keys, Justin Timberlake, Rihanna and more.

We’re hoping that some or all of those names make cameos during Jay’s set, but there’s also no reasonable doubt that he has more than enough solo hits to choose from across his 14 Billboard 200 No. 1 albums as well.

The setlist could go anyway, and ultimately, it’s all up to the rapper — but Billboard is still curious about your picks. Tell us which song you most want Jay-Z to perform at the next Super Bowl Halftime Show by voting in the poll below.
